full_judgment:
5. After hearing the parties and considering the evidence and materials on record the Senior Assistant Judge, Comilla, by his judgment and decree dated 17.04.2006 dismissed the suit. 

 6. Against the said judgment and decree passed by the trial Court, the plaintiffs preferred Title Appeal No. 124 of 2006 before the District Judge, Comilla, who after hearing the parties and considering the materials on record, by his judgment and decree dated 02.04.2007 dismissed the appeal upholding the judgment and decree passed by the trial Court. 

 7. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree of the appellate Court, the plaintiffs filed Civil Revision No. 2564 of 2007 before the High Court Division and obtained Rule, which upon hearing the parties and considering the materials on record, was made absolute. Hence, the defendants filed the instant civil petition for leave to appeal before this Division.
